diagnosis: The ticket reports a recurring issue but provides no specifics about the service, error, or prior incident. It cannot be routed to a fix without details from the customer.
reply: Thanks for reaching out, and sorry for the frustration with the recurring problem. To help us investigate, could you share what specifically is breaking — which service or feature, any error messages you are seeing, and roughly when it last occurred? Any reference to the earlier occurrence would also help us connect the cases. I have recommended this ticket for escalation to a specialist.
